scope.focus: Linux as a complete operating environment and researchable system: user space, portable interfaces, administration, observability, kernel-facing behavior, subsystem internals, performance, security, kernel development, and Linux-oriented systems research.
includes: System mental models and safe experimentation
Filesystems, storage, identity, processes and services
Linux security, namespaces, cgroups and virtualization
Kernel build, internals, subsystems and contribution workflow
Research literacy and open Linux systems questions
delegates: Full hardware/microarchitecture treatment belongs to Computer Architecture.
General operating-system theory can be deepened in Computer Systems rather than duplicated.
Full C++ and parallel-programming treatments belong to their canonical tracks.
